description: This is a unit test class for the ShutdownReasonFactory component within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.common package. It tests JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, and handling of different JSON inputs related to shutdown reasons.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonFactoryTest
classes.description: A unit test class verifying the behavior of ShutdownReasonFactory, focusing on JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, and handling of different JSON inputs.

methods.name: initTestConstants

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ShutdownReasonFactory class is immutable.

methods.name: getPurgeNamespaceReasonFromJson
methods.description: Tests that JSON for purge namespace reason correctly maps to the factory method output.

methods.description: Tests that JSON for purge entities reason correctly maps to the factory method output.

methods.name: fromJsonWithoutType
